svg.text: Cut 320 mm of 40 x 5 mm bar. Bend 90 degrees the easy way (across

svg.text: the 5 mm) in a vice with a radius block, to an L: long leg 251 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and short leg 70 mm, outside sizes. The short leg stands up.
